# Modifications and licensing boundaries

Modified on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21 by Zotero Codex Translate contributors.

Public v0.1.0 consolidates the local development 0.1.1–0.1.6 changes recorded below. Project and bridge versions are reset to 0.1.0 for this authorized public release; historical identifiers remain to preserve the modification record. Upstream licenses, author notices, pinned dependencies and PDF behavior are unchanged.

Local fixes on 2026-10-21 (0.1.1 and 0.1.2): connection lifecycle isolation, startup diagnostics and repair controls; packed license-text loading; in-document radio choice lists replacing unsupported HTML select popups in the translation dialog. These project changes preserve all original upstream notices and grants.

Local 0.1.3 on 2026-10-21: project-level background task management and non-focusing notifications; isolated batch requests through Codex app-server; page/paragraph diagnostics and same-page reflow using BabelDOC's glyph/formula APIs, plus source raster-region restoration. These adaptations are confined to the project's bridge and UI; the pinned upstream BabelDOC wheel remains unmodified and retains its original license. Source and test scripts for all project modifications accompany the XPI.

Local 0.1.4 on 2026-10-21: remove the custom BabelDOC typesetting interception, full-page reflow and raster repainting added in 0.1.3; use native output with observational content/font/bounds/overlap validation. Add cache-only layout jobs, bidirectional page/relative-position synchronization and reader toolbar comparison controls. The pinned BabelDOC wheel is unchanged. Disable the bundled toolkit's unused reader-keyboard poller to avoid callbacks on disposed readers; split-reader input handlers remain owned by this project. All new and modified bridge, reader and test sources accompany this local distribution.

Local 0.1.5 on 2026-10-21: remove remaining internal translator interception and custom output-layout gates; use public BabelDOC API and translator extension; copy openable output unchanged; recover previously generated PDFs into independent, idempotent records. Older 0.1.4 used native typesetting but still intercepted translation internals and enforced extra output checks; its description did not mean an entirely public-API-only integration.

Local 0.1.6 on 2026-10-21: retain per-document toolbar nodes across custom-section rebuilds; share per-tab comparison transition guards; use stock toolbar classes and theme-based focus/selection rings, with lifecycle cleanup. Native-input diagnostic controllers are isolated from the distributed production addon. BabelDOC invocation and PDF output handling are unchanged; generatedByVersion now reads the bridge version constant.

- Split-View Reader, commit `600f1bd99d9a52a99683702f6681bf34b83bfec3`, Fuling Lin and contributors: new plugin identity and menu/settings workflow; translation-pair opening; namespace isolation; corresponding-page synchronization; integration lifecycle fixes. Its original AGPL-3.0-or-later grant is preserved, including `notices/split-view-LICENSE.txt` and package metadata. The project exercises the version 3 option for this combined distribution. New bridge/installer code is AGPL-3.0-only; this does not remove the upstream grant.
- Upstream plugin template/toolkit and Zotero bootstrap notices remain in source. The bundled toolkit is windingwind's MIT-licensed zotero-plugin-toolkit 5.1.0-beta.13; its complete license is retained.
- Material Symbols SVGs copied through Split-View Reader retain Google's Apache-2.0 license. `do_not_splitscreen_vertical_24dp.svg` includes an added slash/opacity change from upstream. The `svreader.svg` logo is retained from the pinned Split-View Reader tree under its project license.
- BabelDOC 0.6.4 is downloaded unmodified. As of 0.1.5, `pdf_engine.py` calls the public TranslationConfig / async_translate API and a BaseTranslator extension, inheriting its translate entry point. Runtime ILTranslator method replacement and Path.home replacement have been removed. Asset paths are initialized through the worker environment, restored before Codex starts. There is no project PDF layout editing or font/overlap/content-count rejection. The pinned source archive and original notices are preserved.
- Font and ONNX binaries are downloaded byte-for-byte from the pinned resource manifest, checked against BabelDOC 0.6.4 hashes. This project does not modify, rename or relicense those binaries. Font metadata copyright and reserved names are recorded in `runtime/font-provenance.json`; fonts retain OFL-1.1. Documents produced using fonts are governed separately from the font software.

No upstream author or vendor endorses this project. Codex CLI is a separately installed prerequisite, not distributed in the XPI. Runtime tools and wheels are fetched directly from their upstreams; that distribution boundary does not waive their license terms. See `runtime/dependency-inventory.json` and the original notices for actual component terms.

Version 0.1.1: Linux x64 dedicated-environment bootstrap and locked official wheel provenance; Zotero 10 local compatibility fixes; attachment-note pairing metadata and transactional migration from legacy custom relation URNs; existing-PDF pairing and independent reading for unequal page counts. Changes to the derived Split-View Reader are included as readable TypeScript. Original licenses and all unmodified BabelDOC assets remain unchanged.
